payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches three load-bearing concepts: the async decision widget (core feature / thesis proven), the 23-point velocity metric (prior velocity observation + metric-anchoring style), and the Zephyr integration as key unlock (Zephyr position, webhook architecture, rate-limit blocker). I expanded the prior Sprint 4 retro document for supersession comparison, the two core narratives (DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, DecisionsEvaporate) and the AntiSlack positioning narrative the widget embodies, plus the anti-pattern, context-preservation-next-sprint, pricing, product-category, and target-market positions that frame the product context this retro sits inside. No areas were deliberately excluded — the document is short but its three claims ripple across positioning, architecture, metrics, and pricing.
